title: SGT: Structural-Morphology-Aware Graph Transformer for Fine-Grained Digital Pathology Image Classification (code, splits and test predictions)
description: Source code of SGT (graph construction, training, evaluation, control experiments and statistical tests), the data split files of BRACS, CAMELYON16 and ISIC 2018, and the per-sample test predictions and reports of every run reported in the manuscript. Image data are not included; they are available from the original providers.
